name: Mobbin
summary: Design reference library of real app and website screenshots: browse screens, flows, animations and UI elements.
description: Mobbin is a searchable library of shipped app and website screenshots - 621,500 screens and flows, updated weekly. Browse by app or site, individual screens, multi-step flows, animations and UI elements; use it for product design research, critique and competitive benchmarking. Free to browse, with Pro and Team plans adding MCP and API access for agents.
contains: browse apps, sites, screens, flows, animations and UI elements
searchable tags such as tab bar, onboarding and paywall
MCP server tools: searchscreens, searchflows, searchsections (60 requests/60s)
REST API with workspace bearer keys on Team and Enterprise plans
Pro $10/month; Team $16 per member/month billed yearly; Enterprise custom
free plan to browse with limited access
